description: Read pixel colours of the composite image at points (Color Sampler tool and Info panel), optionally making the first the foreground or background colour (Eyedropper tool) and keeping the samplers in the document

clear.description: Remove the document's existing colour samplers first. Default false

keep.description: Leave colour samplers at the points. Default false

points.description: Pixel positions from the document's top-left

setAs.description: Make the first sampled colour the foreground or background colour (Eyedropper)

name: sample_color
title: Sample Color
